paragraphs: Piper Networks is a rail engineering solutions provider and systems integrator working in transportation technologies. Five primary product lines cover Vital Train Positioning, Maintenance of Way (MOW) Protection, Automatic Train Protection (ATP), Grade Crossing Safety, and Passenger Information Display Systems (PIDS). Those systems combine real-time location technologies including UWB, BLE, GPS-RTK, LTE, RFID, HD cameras and LiDAR.

Amtrak selected the Limits Compliance and Collision Avoidance System (LCCAS) to protect and monitor Maintenance of Way vehicles. Piper is equipping Amtrak vehicles in the Northeast corridor with LCCAS devices and delivering real-time telematics data to the dispatch system. Piper developed the technology behind the MTA countdown clocks at B Division station platforms and mezzanines. Piper and Thales were awarded a Pilot Program for an Ultra-Wideband Based Train Control System to be installed on the 7 (Flushing) Line.

The UWB train control system received a CENELEC Safety Integrity Level 4 (SIL-4) Certification from independent safety assessor TÜV SÜD. Piper states that its multi-sensor system has an accuracy of less than 5cm.

quote.text: Piper provides advanced solutions for train navigation, MOW vehicle protection and railway safety.
